leadText: Chisa Yūki (Japanese: 優希知冴 Yūki Chisa) is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Chisa Yūki (Japanese: 優希知冴 Yūki Chisa) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Yūki was born on August 19, 1989 in , and became voice actress as an adult. She began her work during the , where her only role was Kahili, one of the Elite Four. Yūki is currently affiliated with talent agency Kenyuu Office.
